topic: Water as Basic Need of Living Things
key_concepts: Water is a basic need of plants and animals.
All living organisms need water to survive.
Plants need water to grow and stay healthy.
People use water for drinking and staying healthy.
Rivers, lakes, oceans, groundwater, and rain are sources of water.
Water pipes are man-made sources of water.
Water sources can be natural or man-made.
Watered plants grow well while unwatered plants wilt.
Animals in different habitats obtain water in different ways.
Water conservation helps ensure water is available for living things.
